speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — death-ender?
premises: Bow to you, ender of death, crusher of love.
Gaṅgā on head, doer of what is right as fitting.
inference: Bow to death-ending love-crusher, Gaṅgā-crowned righter.

speaker: Devotee (asking resort)
question: What higher resort without you?
premises: Above even lordship, knowledge, dispassion, dharmas — the standing prayed for.
Without you, O lord, what higher resort for those praying?
inference: No higher resort than you above all attainments.

speaker: Devotee (marveling will)
question: Who bends grass, carries Brahmā's yoke?
premises: When you do not will, who is capable, O Śambhu, to bend grass?
But favoured by your will — who would not carry Brahmā's yoke?
inference: Without your will none bends grass; with it all carry Brahmā's yoke.

option_choices.reason: To-bend (grass bent); hunch same kubjaya, T1 bend kept.

speaker: Devotee (asking homage)
question: To what supreme would wisdom bow?
premises: Heads raised with jewel-crowns of bowing to Hara — the wisdom-rich.
To what supreme would they bow, or whom would they not bend?
inference: Wisdom-rich bow to no supreme but Hara-crowned heads' lord.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (what supreme); other same para, T1 supreme kept.

speaker: Devotee (dwelling)
question: Where dwell?
premises: Tremorless, shed of all wandering, nectar-lake.
The middle of your knowledge-ocean — may I dwell upon, O Dhūrjaṭi.
inference: May I dwell in your knowledge-ocean's tremorless middle.

speaker: Devotee (marveling grant)
question: How grant ultimate fruit?
premises: Wonder that — even strangely seen, even gone into wish.
Ultimate fruit, O lord, full you grant.
inference: Strangely seen or wished, you grant full ultimate fruit — wonder.

option_choices.reason: Strangely-seen (odd manner of seeing); seen-as-wonder same citra, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (bewildered praising)
question: Praise or blame you?
premises: Who is greater than you by virtues? Who attributeless greater than you?
Thus, O lord, we laud — do we praise you? Do we blame? We do not think.
inference: None greater virtned or virtneless; praise or blame — we do not know.

option_choices.reason: We-laud (nu praise); bow same homage, T1 laud kept.

speaker: Devotee (thirsting nectar)
question: Who drinks, who gives nectar-fruit?
premises: Even in praising, of the nectar-flood — of which favour is your fruit.
That to drink, who else is capable — how much more to give, O world-lord?
inference: None can drink your nectar-fruit, much less give it, but you.

option_choices.reason: Favour (grace whose fruit); clarity same prasatti, T1 favour kept.

speaker: Devotee (praying devotion)
question: What pray from the treasury?
premises: From treasury of accomplishment of wholly desirable hosts.
From you, devotion to you alone to obtain I pray, O lord, in every way.
inference: From all-desire treasury, pray only devotion to you.

speaker: Devotee (bowing to power)
question: To what unimpeded power bow?
premises: Bow to three-world-lord, to you, O Bhava.
Of those attending you — to unimpeded power giving three-world-lordship.
inference: Bow to unimpeded three-world-lordship power of your attendants' lord.
